name: minus
description: Represents removing or subtracting. On hover the bar sweeps in from the left — the removal stroke asserted.

animation.description: The bar arrives from the left (x -5 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, 0.2s easeOut). One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context for what is being removed when used in a button.
